propositions: A nested rebar bridge command group exposes only preview and sync verbs with pinned contracts; preview enforces dry-run mode and sync enforces live mode.
The bridge group rejects --mode, --filter-local-ids, and arbitrary trailing arguments to prevent callers from overriding the read/write distinction.
Bridge preview performs zero Jira writes and zero ticket/bridge-state writes, proven by exact before/after snapshots and transport logs.
Bridge sync performs persisted mutations from production-shaped fixtures while preserving unrelated state bytes.
Unknown nested verbs fail with valid choices and never dispatch a same-named top-level command; help output excludes mode, rank, gate, lock, cap, pass, binding store, and numeric exit codes.
All legacy top-level spellings (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, doctor) remain functionally unchanged with existing dispatch and initialization policies.
